Seller guide

A clear workspace for your store.

Apply as a seller, create country-tagged product listings and manage their review status on Market is Online.

Apply to become a seller

Use Sell with us to submit your business name, contact details, business country, product categories and proposed commercial terms. Registration must be open. Complete your member registration first if prompted.

Review your commercial terms

Your application may need additional review or acceptance of the offered terms before approval. The application status shows the next step. Product prices, commissions and awarded PPV use the approved, editable settings.

Create a listing

In Seller Centre, select New listing and choose your approved store. Enter the product name, description, category, country, price, stock and product photos. Save a draft or submit it for review.

Manage existing listings

Existing listings show the product image, name, country, status and available actions. Use search and status filters to find a product, edit its details or update price and stock.

Respond to a review

Open a listing’s review note when changes are requested. Keep product information accurate and resubmit after making the requested corrections. Admin review determines publication status.

Track your store

Use the seller tools available in your account to review sales and withdrawal requests. Contact support if an application or product needs assistance.
